name: B Testimonials Block – Boost Credibility with Customer Reviews
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn happy customers into your best salespeople – display ratings and reviews that build instant trust with every visitor.

Demos

Why B Testimonials Block?

Visitors trust other customers more than they trust marketing copy. B Testimonials Block lets you display customer ratings and reviews seamlessly on your website, boosting trust and credibility by highlighting positive feedback from satisfied customers.

Everything is configured right in the Gutenberg editor. Pick a layout – Default, Slider, or Masonry – choose from seven theme styles, and fine-tune columns, gaps, cards, images, and typography until the testimonials match your design perfectly.

Free Features

  • Three Layout Options: Display testimonials in Default, Slider, or Masonry layout.
  • Seven Theme Styles: Choose from Default, Theme 1, Theme 2, Theme 3, Theme 4, Theme 5, and Theme 6.
  • Responsive Columns: Configure columns per device and adjust column gap and row gap for precise layout control.
  • Card Customization: Modify the card background color, padding, border, and shadow.
  • Image Settings: Control image width, height, and border styling.
  • Typography & Colors: Personalize name, designation, and review text with custom typography and color settings.
  • Rating & Excerpt Control: Modify the rating color and set the excerpt length to control how much review text is shown.

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the B Testimonials Block plugin.
  2. Open a post or page in the Gutenberg editor.
  3. Add the B Testimonials block from the “Widgets” block category.
  4. Add your testimonials and adjust layout, theme, and style settings from the right-side sidebar.
  5. Publish – your testimonials are live!

Use Cases

  • Business Websites: Show client feedback that builds confidence in your services.
  • Online Stores: Highlight product reviews and star ratings to encourage purchases.
  • Agencies & Freelancers: Present client testimonials as social proof on portfolio pages.
  • Local Businesses: Feature happy-customer quotes on your homepage and landing pages.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “B Testimonials Block”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the B Testimonials block to any post or page in the Gutenberg editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the B Testimonials Block plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the b-testimonials-block.zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin, then add the block from the Gutenberg editor.

Alternatively, upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is B Testimonials Block free?

Yes, B Testimonials Block is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change all block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

What layouts does the block support?

You can choose from three layout options: Default, Slider, and Masonry.

Can I display star ratings with each testimonial?

Yes. Each testimonial can show a rating, and you can customize the rating color to match your design.

Can I control how the testimonials look on mobile?

Yes. You can configure the number of columns per device and adjust column and row gaps for precise responsive control.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block an unlimited number of times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
